note: Lassen NF campground under tall pines and firs along Deer Creek in its canyon on Hwy 32, popular for trout fishing and escaping the valley heat. Only some sites suit RVs, and parking for extra vehicles is very limited. Pay on arrival. --Claude
summary: FS page + RIDB + imagery read. Open; 32 FCFS sites (some RV-capable), vault toilets, potable water, $14, 2 vehicles / 8 people; no rec.gov listing (RIDB 248938 not reservable). Season mid-April - October (was Apr 1 - Nov 30, approximate). Not waterfront kept (dense canopy). Pin OK (~60 m from the FS point).
flags: RIG: no length published; FS: 'Some sites equipped to accommodate RVs'. Paved Hwy 32 access, no access warning. Unclear pad size = keep.

WATERFRONT: not waterfront kept - FS 'along Deer Creek', but the imagery shows unbroken conifer canopy over the sites and the creek (canopy defaults down; no site-level statement of creek access). Possible creekside if AWH reads 'along Deer Creek' as walk-down access; no site numbers available.
BOOKING: no recreation.gov listing (RIDB 248938 'Reservable False', rec.gov campground page 404) -> first-come only, confirmed by FS.
